posts.author: TottenhamHotspur
posts.text: Q3 2026 oppdateringen er et stort gjespsynes jeg:  «on track» som alltid✌️ 94% superior share er litt ned fra tidligere👎 3 kg HOG = gedigen smolt👎 Ikke overraskende hvis shorterne presser aksjen videre ned😭 Fra Q3 rapporten: Harvested 1,596 tonnes HOG at an all-in price realization of ~NOK 65/kg, up ~7% y/y; superior share of 94% in line with the long-term trend. Net biomass growth of 1,984 tonnes LW, held back by one underperforming Phase 1 group representing ~25% of tank capacity in the quarter, now fully harvested as planned by end-Q3. Average harvest weight of 3.0 kg HOG reflects that group; Q4-26 phase 1 harvest weights are expected in the mid-to-high end of the 3–4 kg range. Phase 2 have the required smolt stocking frequency from Q4-26 to reach targeted production run-rate by mid-27.
